objective: Establish GitHub as the durable coordination plane between ChatGPT, Windsurf, VS Code Copilot, PC/GPU certification, deployment evidence, and human review.
in_scope: Add versioned task, run-report, and local-certification schemas with validated examples.
Add a standard-library control-plane CLI for validation, report creation, branch planning, PR-body generation, and deterministic self-tests.
Add GitHub issue, pull-request, custom-agent, and Actions integration.
Add DrumTracKAI-specific fail-closed agent rules for generation, model readiness, artifacts, calibration, and deployment evidence.
Add Windsurf rules and workflows that read GitHub tasks and PR feedback directly.
Document secure GitHub MCP setup for the DrumTracKAI PC and studio Mac.
Document StudioMind and DrumTracKAI execution lanes and cross-repository authority boundaries.
out_of_scope: Installing or authenticating MCP on the user's local machines.
Changing DrumTracKAI generation, calibration, database, frontend, model, artifact, or deployment behavior.
Creating a GitHub Project board or modifying repository protection settings.
Granting credentials, GPU/deployment access, repository permissions, or autonomous merge authority.
acceptance_criteria: All control-plane examples validate against schema version 1.0.0.
The self-test rejects a task that targets main and a completed report without a full commit SHA.
GitHub Actions validates the control-plane utility and examples on push and pull request changes.
Windsurf and Copilot agents follow the issue, run-report, draft-PR, direct-review-comment, and local-certification workflow.
DrumTracKAI agent instructions require explicit failure or degraded states instead of silent model, transformer, renderer, or artifact fallback.
The repository contains current secure setup instructions for GitHub MCP in Windsurf and VS Code.
No credentials, private audio, licensed content, checkpoints, absolute workstation paths, or product runtime changes are introduced.
validation: GitHub Actions: Agent control plane validation
required_evidence: GitHub Actions checks on the draft pull request
dependencies: GitHub App write access to DrGoo1/DrumTracKAI-Full
Manual OAuth or fine-grained credential authorization on each local IDE
local_capabilities: Windsurf and GitHub MCP on the PC after manual setup
VS Code Copilot and GitHub MCP on the studio Mac after manual setup
notes: Bootstrap task created with the control plane it installs.
The active integration base is sync/render-main rather than stale main.
The PR remains draft until automated checks are observed.
